Senior Backend Engineer (Consultant assignment)

Client: Example Retail Group
Location: Stockholm
Start: 2026-09-15
Duration: 6 months with option to extend
Extent: 100%

About the assignment

The client is consolidating three order-management services into one platform and
needs an experienced backend engineer to own the migration of the payment
reconciliation flow. You will work in a team of five, alongside the client's own
architects, and you are expected to take design decisions rather than wait for
them.

Requirements

- Several years of professional Python experience, including async frameworks
- Relational database modelling and query tuning under production load
- Practical experience running services on a managed container platform
- Working Swedish and professional English

Nice to have

- Message-queue based integration work
- Prior consulting experience in retail or logistics

Applications are reviewed continuously and the assignment may be filled before
the stated closing date.
